caption: The drawing depicts an iron door grill set within a rectangular frame that represents a section of a wooden door or wall. The grill consists of a series of vertical, evenly spaced iron bars with rounded tops, each bar meeting a solid horizontal band at both the top and the bottom. The upper and lower sections of the grill are adorned with a lattice pattern formed by interlocking diagonal bars, creating diamond shapes that contain small circular elements at each intersection. The vertical bars are intersected at the top and bottom by more elaborate, decorative elements that are symmetrical and evenly spaced. The entire composition is rendered in black ink on a beige background, and a simple, thin, double-lined decorative border encloses the drawing. Below the grill, the text "IRON DOOR GRILL" is centered and written in uppercase serif letters.
title: Cast Iron Balcony Railing
